name: Werewolves
description: Find the werewolves before they take the village.
howToPlay: Everyone gets a secret role: villager, werewolf, seer or doctor.
At night, the werewolves pick a victim, the seer checks someone and the doctor protects someone.
By day, everyone talks and votes someone out.
The village wins when the werewolves are gone; the werewolves win when they equal the village.

nb.name: Varulver
nb.description: Finn varulvene før de tar landsbyen.
howToPlay: Alle får en hemmelig rolle: landsbyboer, varulv, spåkone eller lege.
Om natten velger varulvene et offer, spåkona sjekker noen og legen beskytter noen.
Om dagen snakker alle og stemmer ut en spiller.
Landsbyen vinner når varulvene er borte; varulvene vinner når de er like mange som landsbyen.
